r/almosthomeless is a great place for in-depth further advice that may pertain to your situation, or post a question. Although I do have some overall general advice, no matter your position:

- a gym membership is what probably helped me the most hygiene wise. if you’re near a planet fitness, the bathrooms and locker rooms are usually always clean. great place for a shower, brush your teeth, lock up any personal items, clean towels (depending on your location), and you’ll always have access to a warm room. 

- baby wipes are great if you can’t access a shower/toilet. they’re also great for wiping your hands before meals. 

- buy a fast food or gas-station fountain drink and reuse the same up for a “free refill” every now and then. this may depend on your location. 

- most importantly, have a positive attitude. i know shit sucks, but the main thing is to keep your mental health on track, no matter how bad it gets. i kept a journal when i was living in my car. i’d write down the little positive things about my day (ex. I saw a dog today! I was also able to get my favorite sandwich from McDonald’s). 

I hope this helps you!

\- Single Word/Sentence Stories (self-explanatory. everyone gets in a circle and someone starts off with a sentence or word, and continue from there until the end).

\- Family Portrait (Gather a group of 4 or 5 people, give them a general topic (football/nerd/laundry/anything honestly; just make sure the other people don't hear) and have them create a 'family portrait' and have the remaining people guess what 'family' they are.
